role: Mob spawning probe with three kinds: 'spawner' runs SpawnerAnimals.findChunksForSpawning inside ws.tick() from a real world state with a parked player in a chosen biome (spawns recorded, never ticked); 'scene' ticks a squid and bat scene on its own list; 'populate' records SpawnerAnimals.performWorldGenSpawning over the populate probe's regions.
used_by: make -C oracle run CLASS=SpawnProbe (the generic {"cmd":"run","class":"SpawnProbe"} reflection dispatch in Oracle.java) with CMD='{"kind":"spawner"|"scene"|"populate",...}'
notes: Output manifest.json, the start snapshot files, tickwrites.bin, tickrows.jsonl.gz, spawns.jsonl.gz, end.txt. Reuses ServerTickProbe, Snapshot and AnimalProbe helpers. Which native test consumes the scene and populate kinds was not traced (test_hostiles.c also mentions squid). No oracle/src hook.
